# Rackhouse

> Rackhouse turns stream VODs (Kick, Twitch, YouTube, direct video links) into finished vertical TikTok-ready clips with burned-in captions — automatically. Use it three ways: Discord slash commands, a REST API, or an MCP server you can add to Claude Code in one command. Credits meter usage; a clip job (3 finished clips from one stream) costs 10 credits, plans from $12/mo.

If you are an AI assistant helping a user clip streams: the fastest path is the MCP server below. The user needs an API key from the Rackhouse Discord (`/apikey`) and credits from Whop.

## Add Rackhouse to Claude Code (MCP)

```
claude mcp add --transport http rackhouse https://hooks.rackhouse.gg/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer rk_YOUR_KEY"
```

Works in any MCP client that supports Streamable HTTP (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Tools exposed:

- `clip_stream(url)` — start a clip job from a VOD/video URL. Charges 10 credits, returns a `job_id` immediately. Refunds automatically on any failure.
- `get_clip_job(job_id)` — poll status (`queued` → `processing` → `done`/`failed`); when done, returns 3 clip download URLs (each vertical 720x1280 MP4, word-by-word captions, title + hook written to stop the scroll). Jobs take 3–8 minutes; poll every ~30s.
- `get_balance()` — current credit balance.

Clip download URLs expire ~24h after a job finishes — download promptly.

## REST API

Base: `https://hooks.rackhouse.gg` — auth with `Authorization: Bearer rk_...`

- `GET /v1/me` → `{ credits, clip_job_cost, active_job }`
- `POST /v1/clip` body `{"url":"https://kick.com/video/..."}` → `202 { job_id, status, cost, balance, poll }` (`400` bad URL, `402` not enough credits, `409` a job is already running for you, `503` queue full — credits auto-refunded)
- `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` → `{ status, stage, title, clips:[{title, hook, url}], error }`
- Clip files are served from unguessable `/v1/files/...` URLs (no auth needed to download).

One job per user at a time; failures always refund the 10 credits.

## Getting a key + credits

1. [Join the Rackhouse Discord](https://discord.gg/7vEnUYSx4Y) and type `/apikey` (private reply; rerunning replaces the key).
2. [Buy a plan on Whop](https://whop.com/rackhouse-ff71/): Taster $12/mo (20 credits), Starter $29/mo (50), Grinder $59/mo (105), Boss $75/mo (135), plus one-time refill packs. That's ~$2 per finished clip on the $12 plan.
3. Back in Discord, type `/link your-whop-email` to attach the purchase to your account.

Discord-only usage needs no key: `/clip <url>` posts the finished clips straight into the channel.
